run_eval_whisper_model: run eval on a distil-whisper model using Flax on one or more evaluation datasets
build_data_collator_speech_seq2seq: build a data collator that dynamically pads speech input features and target label sequences for seq2seq evaluation
convert_dataset_str_to_list: convert a plus-separated dataset name string into a list of dataset config dicts with name, config, split, and column info
compute_wer_metrics: compute word error rate metrics with orthographic spacing and English text normalization on predicted and reference transcriptions
write_wandb_predictions: write predicted and reference transcriptions as a wandb table including audio samples and incorrect prediction rows
